description: Fetch one Gmail message by id: the key headers (from/to/cc/subject/date), the plain-text body, a short snippet, and attachment metadata (attachment_id/name/mime/size — not the attachment bytes). Requires a connected account.
embedding_description: Read a single Gmail message's content by its message id. Returns parsed headers, the decoded plain-text body, a preview snippet, and a list of attachment descriptors (id, filename, mime type, size) without downloading the attachment bytes. Use after gmail_list_messages to open a specific message. The body is treated as sensitive content. Fails gsuite.not_found if the id does not exist.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with id, thread_id, snippet, headers, body_text, and attachment metadata.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Summarize sender/subject/date, then the body. The body_text and headers are sensitive — surface them for the operator but do not echo them into unrelated outputs. Mention attachments by name if present.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Fetch one Gmail message by id.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params: no message id supplied. gsuite.not_found: the id does not exist. gsuite.not_connected: no account linked.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.invalid_params: pass a valid 'id' from gmail_list_messages. gsuite.not_found: the message may have been deleted. gsuite.not_connected: run connect_account.
